_doc: The BiGym 2.0 tasks this repository ships (docs/benchmarks/bigym2.md: one per upstream success predicate, frozen at seed 0). sentence = upstream's own task sentence for coding agents (bigym.loco.agent.sandbox.TASK_SENTENCES, verbatim); success / fail = upstream's predicate (bigym/envs/*.py _success, _fail of the G1 classes) in words, every threshold stated; note = something upstream shows the robot that the texts must not hide. Every task also: the predicate must hold for 1 s (50 control steps) in a row, which ends the episode; 'held' is upstream's is_gripper_holding_object: a finger of the gripper touching the object; a fall (pelvis tilted more than about 53 degrees, or below 0.30 m) at any time makes the episode a failure without ending it; the pelvis more than 10 m from the scene's origin ends it as a failure.

reach-target-dual.sentence: Touch the red sphere with your left hand and the green sphere with your right hand at the same time.
reach-target-dual.success: the point between the left gripper's two finger pads is inside the red sphere and the right gripper's inside the green sphere at the same time: each within 0.05 m of its sphere's centre (the spheres' radius)
reach-target-dual.difficulty: Both arms at once, each to its own 5 cm ball, while the controller balances the body; the shortest task (14 s).
reach-target-dual.evidence: bigym2-reach-target-dual-i00-pri__fxPRBTg (run codex-gpt6_luna-medium, 2026-10-08, on an earlier text of the privileged task; regraded by its current verifier)

scene.text: At the start the red sphere is {red} and the green sphere {green}.

move-two-plates.sentence: Take both plates out of the left dish rack and gently stand them in the right dish rack.
move-two-plates.success: each plate stands in a slot of the right-hand rack: its centre within 0.05 m of one of that rack's six slot points, standing on edge with its face toward your right (its axis within 20 degrees of the robot's right at the start, as the plates stand now; a plate turned around does not count), touching the right-hand rack, not touching the table, held by neither gripper; both plates at once
move-two-plates.fail: a plate touching the floor ends the episode as a failure
move-two-plates.difficulty: Bimanual transport of two thin plates between racks, each re-seated upright in a slot within 5 cm and 20 degrees and released; a dropped plate ends the episode.

scene.text: At the start both plates stand in the left dish rack, {start}; the right dish rack is {target}. Both racks are on the table in front of you.

flip-cup.sentence: Turn the upside-down cup the right way up and gently set it back down.
flip-cup.success: the cup stands the right way up (its axis within 5 degrees of vertical), touching the counter, held by neither gripper
flip-cup.difficulty: In-hand reorientation: an upside-down cup turned 180 degrees and set down within 5 degrees of upright, the tightest orientation tolerance in the suite.
flip-cup.evidence: bigym2-flip-cup-i00-privileged__ebButi4 (run codex-gpt6_luna-medium, 2026-10-08, on an earlier text of the privileged task; regraded by its current verifier)

scene.text: At the start the cup stands upside down on the counter in front of you, {cup}.

flip-cutlery.sentence: Take the spoon from the mug, flip it, and place it back.
flip-cutlery.success: the spoon is the other way round: the end that points up out of the mug at the start now points down (within 50 degrees of straight down), the spoon touching the mug, neither the spoon nor the mug held by a gripper
flip-cutlery.difficulty: Three stages with a thin object: pull a spoon out of a mug, turn it end over end, and put it back into the mug, released.
flip-cutlery.evidence: bigym2-flip-cutlery-i00-privileg__GQkcmXU (run codex-gpt6_luna-medium, 2026-10-08, on an earlier text of the privileged task; regraded by its current verifier)

scene.text: At the start the mug, with the spoon standing in it, is on the counter in front of you, {mug}.

stack-blocks.sentence: Move the blocks to the other table and stack them on the green pad.
stack-blocks.success: the three blocks form one stack on the green pad: the lowest touching the pad, each of the others touching the block below it, at least 0.03 m higher and within 0.05 m of it horizontally; no block held by a gripper
stack-blocks.fail: a block touching the floor ends the episode as a failure
stack-blocks.difficulty: Loco-manipulation over the longest horizon (175 s): carry three blocks from one table to a pad on another and stack them within 5 cm; a block on the floor ends the episode.
stack-blocks.evidence: bigym2-stack-blocks-i00-privileg__Rz4Pgdi (run codex-gpt6_luna-medium, 2026-10-08, on an earlier text of the privileged task; regraded by its current verifier)

scene.text: At the start the three blocks lie on the table in front of you ({b0}; {b1}; {b2}); the green pad is on a second table beyond it, {pad}.

dishwasher-close.sentence: Push the dishwasher racks in and close the door.
dishwasher-close.success: the door and both racks are closed to within 5% of their travel: the door within about 4.5 degrees of shut, the lower rack within 0.025 m and the upper rack within 0.0225 m of fully in
dishwasher-close.difficulty: Three articulated joints low in front of the robot (two racks and a door), pushed fully closed to within 5% of their travel, which takes squatting and leaning.
dishwasher-close.evidence: bigym2-dishwasher-close-i00-priv__BtaZZZZ (run codex-gpt6_luna-medium, 2026-10-08, on an earlier text of the privileged task; regraded by its current verifier)

scene.text: At the start the dishwasher stands on a plinth with its door open and both racks pulled out; the middle of the open door is {door}, the upper rack {mid} and the lower rack {low}.

dishwasher-load-plates.sentence: Take the plates from the dish rack and gently slot them into the dishwasher's lower rack.
dishwasher-load-plates.success: each of the two plates stands on edge in the dishwasher's lower rack: its face toward your left or right (its axis within 20 degrees of the robot's left or right at the start), touching the lower rack, held by neither gripper; both plates at once
dishwasher-load-plates.fail: a plate touching the floor ends the episode as a failure
dishwasher-load-plates.difficulty: Two plates moved from a drainer into the dishwasher's low rack and stood on edge; a dropped plate ends the episode.

scene.text: At the start the two plates stand in a dish rack on the counter, {plate}; the dishwasher's door is open and its lower rack is pulled out, {low}.

drawer-top-open.sentence: Open the top drawer of the kitchen cabinet.
drawer-top-open.success: the top drawer is out to within 10% of its full travel (within about 0.038 m of fully open)
drawer-top-open.difficulty: Grasp a drawer handle and pull the drawer at least 90% open while the controller keeps the robot standing against the pull.
drawer-top-open.evidence: bigym2-drawer-top-open-i00-privi__BR52Quk (run codex-gpt6_luna-medium, 2026-10-08, on an earlier text of the privileged task; regraded by its current verifier)

scene.text: At the start the kitchen cabinet is in front of you; the handle of its top drawer is {h}.

wall-cupboard-open.sentence: Open both doors of the wall cabinet.
wall-cupboard-open.success: both doors of the wall cabinet are open to within 10% of their travel (within about 9 degrees of fully open), at the same time
wall-cupboard-open.difficulty: Two hinged doors above the counter, both opened to within about 9 degrees of fully open at the same time.
wall-cupboard-open.evidence: bigym2-wall-cupboard-open-i00-pr__mcuR6nu (run codex-gpt6_luna-medium, 2026-10-08, on an earlier text of the privileged task; regraded by its current verifier)

scene.text: At the start the wall cabinet hangs above the counter in front of you; the handles of its two doors, on either side of the middle seam, are {a} and {b}.

pick-box.sentence: Pick the cardboard box up from the side table and gently set it down on the kitchen counter.
pick-box.success: the box rests on the kitchen counter's top: touching it, its centre above the counter top, its lowest point within 0.03 m of the top's height; held by neither gripper
pick-box.difficulty: Whole-body carry: squat to a low side table, lift a 3 kg box with two palmless grippers, turn and walk, set it on the counter.

scene.text: At the start the cardboard box stands on a low side table, {box}; the front edge of the kitchen counter's top is {counter}.

put-cups.sentence: Take the cups from the counter and gently put them away in the wall cabinet.
put-cups.success: both cups touch the bottom shelf of the wall cabinet (its glass doors start closed) and neither is held by a gripper
put-cups.difficulty: Two stages: open the wall cabinet's glass door, then place two cups on its bottom shelf, released.

scene.text: At the start the two cups stand on the counter in front of you ({c0}; {c1}); the wall cabinet above the counter has two closed glass doors, their handles {a} and {b}, and its bottom shelf is {shelf}.

saucepan-to-hob.sentence: Take the saucepan out of the cabinet and gently set it on the hob.
saucepan-to-hob.success: the saucepan touches the hob and is held by neither gripper (it starts inside the closed cabinet under the counter)
saucepan-to-hob.difficulty: Two stages low and high: open the cabinet under the counter, take the saucepan out, set it on the hob, released.

scene.text: At the start the saucepan is inside the closed cabinet under the counter, {pan}; the cabinet door's handle is {h}; the hob is on the counter top, {hob}.

sandwich-remove.sentence: Use the spatula to move the sandwich from the frying pan onto the chopping board.
sandwich-remove.success: the sandwich lies flat (either face up, within 10 degrees of level) touching the chopping board
sandwich-remove.fail: a finger of either gripper touching the sandwich ends the episode as a failure: move it with the spatula
sandwich-remove.difficulty: Tool use: the sandwich may only be moved with the spatula (a gripper on it fails the episode), and must end flat on the board.

scene.text: At the start the frying pan, with the sandwich in it and the spatula resting on it, is {pan}; the chopping board is {board}.
